nodes.title: Measure–influence form of KKL with constant 0 holds trivially

nodes.summary: The KKL inequality at `p = 1/2` in Fourier form, with the bound `m - m^{2/(1+ρ²)} ≤ (1 - ρ²) I / 4` (for all `ρ ∈ [0, 1]`) as a hypothesis, where `m` is the measure and `I` the total influence of `φ`. The hypothesis always holds (`klo_master_le`).
nodes.title: Fourier-form KKL inequality given the measure–influence bound

nodes.summary: Edge-isoperimetric inequality on the discrete cube (S. Hart, *A note on the edges of the n-cube*, Discrete Math. 1976): an event of uniform measure `m > 0` has total influence at least `2 m log (1 / m)`. Here `log` is the natural logarithm, so this is weaker by the factor `log 2` than the sharp bound `2 m log₂ (1 / m)`.
nodes.title: Edge-isoperimetric inequality
Measure–influence form of KKL implies the indicator-bound form

nodes.summary: For an event of uniform measure `m` and total influence `I = ∑_S 4 |S| f̂(S)²`, `m - m^{2/(1+ρ²)} ≤ (1 - ρ²) I / 4` for `0 ≤ ρ ≤ 1`.
nodes.title: Bound on $m - m^{2/(1+\rho^2)}$ by total influence

nodes.summary: Bernoulli's inequality in the form `1 - x^k ≤ k (1 - x)` for `0 ≤ x` (the hypothesis `x ≤ 1` is not needed). See also `one_add_mul_le_pow`.
